name: contacts
description: Read and manage Apple Contacts through the macOS Contacts framework.

interface.longDescription: Use Apple's Contacts framework directly rather than visual automation: inventory and search raw cards, read structured contact details, discover or add exact directional relationships, add verified email addresses, and add or remove postal addresses with read-back verification.
